name: Niche SEO WordPress plugin / micro-SaaS
one_liner: Build a focused WordPress plugin that does one feature better than big SEO suites, such as internal linking.
customer: Bloggers, niche site owners and content publishers
offer: Paid WordPress plugin (subscription or annual licence) that solves one narrow workflow problem
how_it_makes_money: Recurring annual or monthly licences; exit by selling the business (Link Whisper sold for $2.7M)
startup_cost: medium – the founder's earlier over-built SaaS lost $120k; bootstrapping (small MVP, test pricing early) is the lesson
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; the failed launch made $1,400 in its first week
evidence: Sold WordPress plugin Link Whisper for $2.7 million – eVldld15cXo
Idea came from his own blogging pain: internal links get harder as the post count grows – eVldld15cXo
Gap approach: find a feature that Yoast/Ahrefs/Semrush do poorly – eVldld15cXo
Invested $120k in Table Labs and made $1,400 in launch week; then a bootstrapped SaaS made >$1M – czzv3o0PCmI
risks: Needs a developer or coding skill
Big players can copy the feature

name: Grant-funded online vocational course
one_liner: Sell an online trade-skills course (e.g. forklift technician) whose tuition is paid by government workforce training grants.
customer: Job seekers whose tuition is covered by state workforce grants; also some self-paying general-market buyers
offer: Online certification course in a trade (forklift repair, HVAC, pool cleaning, dog grooming)
how_it_makes_money: Course sold for $12k–15k per student, paid by the grant up to the state's cap; the claim is 80–90% margins
startup_cost: low (stated 'very low startup costs'; no financial reserves needed)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; did $2.4M in the first calendar year
evidence: 'We did 2.4 million our first calendar year' – g-wMJf4ckK0
Course sold for $12,000–15,000, grant pays the entire tuition – g-wMJf4ckK0
Owner has never driven a forklift; online-only lets him serve all of Texas – g-wMJf4ckK0
Client doing $4–5M/yr with the same model – g-wMJf4ckK0
risks: US-specific grant scheme; UK equivalents (Skills Bootcamps, AEB, apprenticeship levy) need Ofsted/ESFA approval and are much stricter
Depends on policy and funding continuing
Claims are the founder's own, unverified

name: Temporary construction fence rental
one_liner: Rent temporary fencing panels to new construction sites, priced per linear foot per period.
offer: Delivered, installed and removed temporary fence panels
how_it_makes_money: About $4 per linear foot, falling toward $2/ft for long hires; jobs averaged $20–30k; equipment pays back in 1–6 rentals
startup_cost: medium – buying the panels plus transport (amount not stated)
time_to_first_revenue: days – a job could be set up in a day after a walk-in sale
evidence: 'He would make like 20 to 30k a job' – dTnidR4eLus
Made several hundred grand, then sold for $600k after 18 months – dTnidR4eLus
'Pay off all your equipment in like one to six rentals' – dTnidR4eLus
Got customers by walking onto new sites; leads also come from permit filings – dTnidR4eLus
risks: The UK hoarding/Heras market is already established

name: Portable toilet rental for construction and events
one_liner: Rent and service portable toilets to building sites on multi-month contracts and to events.
customer: Construction contractors (legally required sanitation) and event organisers
offer: Unit rental plus a weekly pump-out and restock service
how_it_makes_money: Monthly fee per unit plus weekly service; construction contracts run 6–18 months
startup_cost: medium-high (units plus a service truck; not stated)
evidence: Every active construction site must legally have sanitation on site – edG3nhx3U0k
Contracts run 6–18 months, billed monthly per unit plus weekly service – edG3nhx3U0k
Market served by a small handful of regional operators – edG3nhx3U0k

name: Bee removal plus local honey brand
one_liner: Charge to remove or rehome bee swarms, then turn the rescued colonies into honey and education revenue.
customer: Homeowners and property owners with bee problems; local honey buyers
offer: Live bee removal service, honey sales (online store) and bee education
how_it_makes_money: Removal fees (peak in summer) plus honey sales (about half of revenue); $20k/month total
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; they quit their jobs with zero customers
evidence: Couple makes $20,000 a month; started with under $500 – cob8P3mZ8y8
'Honey is only half of our revenue' – removals pick up in summer when honey slows – cob8P3mZ8y8
First colony from a free swarm trap hung on a tree – cob8P3mZ8y8
risks: UK swarm collection is often done free by beekeeper associations
Hard to scale beyond the local area

name: Niche or local email newsletter grown via Reddit
one_liner: Grow a niche or local newsletter by giving genuinely helpful answers in relevant subreddits, then earn from sponsors and products.
customer: Advertisers or sponsors and subscribers buying the creator's products
offer: Free newsletter monetised by sponsorships and the creator's own products
how_it_makes_money: Sponsorships and product sales; one case earns about $285 per subscriber per year
time_to_first_revenue: months (the Reddit case took 'months and months' before one comment brought 1,500 subscribers)
